experiment: STARTS S1ALT13: 1:3 shell-heavy vs PR88 1:1 ALT under frozen S1 at N15 L=2 Q=2048

hypothesis.one_sentence: At N15 L=2 under frozen S1, a 1:3 shared-then-shells block schedule beats exact PR88 1:1 ALT on Nov3 energy at the same inclusive Q=2048.
hypothesis.not: No S1 start/gain retune. No extra Q. No more L3 ALT stacking. Not a GR patch.

frozen.S1JOINT: exact S1 joint IID C0: nstarts=1 TQA, split_cap(2048,1) K=1019, ncal=4, A=25, live gain, last+Polyak, energy min, engine m2
frozen.S1ALT11: exact PR88 alt_spsa.py: odd k (k%2==0) block A, even k block B. K=1019 => 510 A, 509 B. joint_prefix_K=0.
frozen.S1ALT13: same TQA start, same C0 4 full-vector calibration, same live gain, same last+Polyak. Phase starts at A. k%4==0 updates A (shared Uc/γ); k%4 in {1,2,3} updates B (SNAP shells/β). Leftover steps continue that phase, not dumped to shells. K=1019 => 255 A, 764 B, leftover k=1016..1018 = A,B,B.

blocks.Nov3: A = shared Uc [gamma, theta_K, theta_M] indices 0,1,2; B = all SNAP shells indices 3..8
blocks.QAOA: A = all gamma_l indices 0..L-1; B = all beta_l indices L..2L-1

allocation.S1: One TQA start. Full Q=2048 per arm. K=1019.
allocation.inclusive: All init, calibration, perturbations, candidates, failures inside Q. No free JOINT/ALT prefix.

selection: Lowest counted candidate energy. F post hoc, never selects.

gate.cell: N15 L2 Nov3, n=accepted seeds, energy E_S1ALT13 - E_S1ALT11
gate.pass: bootstrap 95% CI of the mean ΔE lies entirely below 0
gate.otherwise: reject 1:3 vs 1:1 at L=2. Do not retune.
gate.also_report: S1ALT13 vs S1JOINT, S1ALT11 vs S1JOINT
gate.nov3_vs_qaoa_s1alt13: Reported separately. Mark a development energy-win candidate only if Nov3−QAOA mean Δ(E-E0)/N under S1ALT13 CI lies entirely below 0.
gate.gr: Do not patch GR even if the gate passes.
